title: Give every runtime and kind a dispatch label that names the work
action: Lift the dispatch SUBJECT out of the Agent arm so every transport shares it. Today it is computed inside the `_ =>` (claude Agent) branch around prepare.rs:715, which is exactly how the codex branch was missed. Compute it ONCE before the `match` on transport: for kind=="cell" it is '<cell id>: <one_line(title, DESCRIPTION_TITLE_MAX)>' as today; for the other kinds it is '<kind>: <purpose>' when a new optional --purpose <one line> flag is given, and the bare kind otherwise. Register --purpose in the command registry entry for dispatch.prepare (string, optional) and run the regen chain this cell owes. Then: (a) the claude Agent branch keeps rendering '<subject> (<model>)' — byte-identical to today for a titled cell and for a kind with no --purpose; (b) the codex branch's `task_name` (prepare.rs:687) carries the same subject instead of the bare cell id, sanitized to what that field accepts — check the codex spawn_agent schema notes in docs/knowledge/areas/hook-runtime/codex-spawn-agent-dispatch-payload-schema-and-schema-agnosti.md before choosing the sanitization, and keep it short; (c) the cli-exec Bash branch gets NO label — its payload has only `command` and `stdin` — and carries a one-line comment saying so, naming it as a recorded limit rather than an oversight. THE ANTI-RECURRENCE DEVICE, which is the point of this cell: add a matrix test that iterates DISPATCH_RUNTIMES x DISPATCH_KINDS from the constants themselves (never a hand-written list) and asserts, for every pair whose payload carries a label field at all, that the label contains a subject and is not merely a model name or a bare kind — so adding a runtime or a kind fails this test until it is labelled. Plus one case per audited gap: codex task_name carries the title; a non-cell kind with --purpose renders it; a non-cell kind without --purpose keeps today's exact bytes; the existing 'gather (sonnet)' assertion at drivers/tests.rs:446 still holds unchanged.

truths: The subject is computed once and every transport branch reads it
codex task_name carries the cell title, not the bare id
A non-cell kind renders its --purpose when given, and today's bytes when not
The matrix test enumerates the supported pairs from the constants, not a literal list
cli-exec's missing label is named in a comment as a recorded limit
The full declared test suite is green

trace.outcome: Computed the dispatch subject once before the transport match so every runtime/kind pair carries a real label, added --purpose for non-cell kinds, and added the DISPATCH_RUNTIMES x DISPATCH_KINDS matrix test as the anti-recurrence device.
